metrics.name: Reactions
metrics.description: The number of likes/reactions your post received.

metrics.name: Comments
metrics.description: The number of comments your post received. Shows when your post is starting conversations, not just getting seen.

metrics.name: Eng. Rate
metrics.description: The percentage of people who interacted with your post compared to how many saw it. Balances views and actions to show how compelling your posts are.

metrics.name: Views
metrics.description: How many times your post was viewed. Helps you understand how much attention your content gets.
